answer: New agents join with zero standing. Each epoch an agent that attests honestly earns one credit; a missed epoch zeroes the counter. Credits only mature after 75 consecutive epochs, roughly 90 days, and only matured credit may be staked into settlement voting. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes must keep 1,000 live nodes honest for three months, paying 0.05 POA per node per epoch in fees plus hosting, about $28,000 in compute before a single vote counts. A dune is a million wind pulses stacked into a ridge, and tundra does not green up on command; standing accrues one honest season at a time.
